description: This Java class 'DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' wraps and delegates to an Akka 'DiagnosticLoggingAdapter', providing logging functionalities with MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) management and thread-safety considerations.

classes.name: DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: A thread-unsafe final class that wraps an Akka DiagnosticLoggingAdapter, managing MDC entries and providing logging methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter with a given DiagnosticLoggingAdapter and logger name.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isWarningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug level logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error message, attempting to include MDC context.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error with a Throwable cause and message.

methods.name: mdc
methods.description: Returns the current MDC as an immutable map.

methods.name: mdc
methods.description: Sets the MDC with the provided map.

methods.name: getMDC
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current MDC.

methods.name: setMDC
methods.description: Sets the MDC to the provided map.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or removes an MDC entry based on the value; returns the adapter for chaining.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: discardMdcEntries
methods.description: Clears local and actual MDC entries.
